whole_repo.source: git log origin/main; gh pr list

caution: Main is squash-merged and several PR batches were merged minutes apart, so commit dates bound the calendar window (7 days for the whole repo) but not the effort.
The measurements inside the Megatron and FastVideo PRs are dated 2026-11-07, one to two days before those PRs merged.
vLLM had a long prototype phase before this repo's history starts (docs/lessons.md:10-18); its duration is not recorded here.

recorded_facts.fact: The first prototype was about 45k lines with 245 run records and 51 hand repairs; the v1 redesign is about 7.7k lines of code plus 4.4k of tests.
On the same 19 upstream PRs, v1 needed a full restart on 0 (prototype: 2) and went live in place on 8 (prototype: 6).
The orchestrator prompt says the prototype replayed 53 real upstream PRs live before v1.
The first v1 replay on GPUs found 4 bugs the CPU toy could not show; fixed in PRs #52-#55.

VllmLab passed 11/11 conformance on 1x B200 eager, 2x B200 TP2, and 1x B200 V2 FULL_DECODE_ONLY CUDA graphs (including via the unified fastrsi CLI); holder-to-holder TP2 <-> EP2 resharding (reshard_live.py) measured 49.4-52.8 s with --zygote --kvplan reuse and 0.36-1.18 s drain-aware stop (byte-equal 1308/1308 EP2 and 1228/1228 TP2, max |delta logprob| == 0.0); live --scheduling-policy switching measured 0.218-0.374 ms core apply with HTTP 400 FCFS priority validation.

recorded_facts.fact: All Megatron lab measurements are dated 2026-11-07; the lab PRs #72-#88 merged within about 25 minutes on 2026-11-09 UTC, so merge times do not show how long the work took.

Conformance c0-c10 passed 11/11 on 2x GB200 TP2 (0.0428 s install / 0.0152 s undo), 4x GB200 TP2/DP2 (0.0451 / 0.0170 s), and 4x GB200 TP4 (0.0444 / 0.0164 s), including via fastrsi conformance megatron --real.

On 4x GB200 (2026-11-19 NeMo 26.08.01), 30/30 paired 8-layer Qwen3-14B-shaped TP2xDP2 dense runs took 5.52-5.61 s live vs 41.83-42.27 s fresh (0% diff vs fresh), an EP4 MoE 8-gate walkthrough passed (0.119 s install, 0.385 s check), and a 10-cycle warm-fork zygote soak ran in 0.064-0.095 s/fork with 0 FD/VRAM leaks.

upstream_patches.kind: performance edits the hill-climb kept (bit-exact), not patches needed for the conversion
upstream_patches.result: 1 GPU: 6.07-6.13 -> 4.22 s per video (1.44-1.45x fresh; 1.43x live 01-20); 2 GPUs: 4.51-4.54 -> 2.99-3.00 s (1.51x fresh; 1.52x live 01-20); every video bit-identical to the golden
upstream_patches.note: Totals counted from the 20 patch files (01-20). None is proposed upstream yet. Patch 20 replaces patches 15-17's per-layer graph pools with a single-shape shared-pool graph cache and memory headroom budget, eliminating the second-sequence-length OOM (124 -> 243 -> 124 -> 362 -> 124, 0 OOM on 1 and 2 GPUs, bit-exact). The lab hooks in at run time (it patches `Executor.get_class` so the engine always runs in spawned workers).

notes: The added/deleted totals are inflated by PR #68, which copied the kernel into the FastVideo lab (+7,210 lines) before PR #107 moved it to a shared folder.
3,345 of the current lines are the 19 hill-climb patch files, not lab code.
